name: @verter/wasm
description: WASM bindings for Verter's Vue and experimental Svelte compiler host
author: pikax

scripts.clean:wasm: npx shx rm -rf wasm/snippets && npx shx rm -f wasm/verter_wasm.js wasm/verter_wasm.d.ts wasm/verter_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts wasm/package.json wasm/README.md wasm/LICENSE
scripts.build:bindgen: pnpm run clean:wasm && cargo build --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml --release -p verter_wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm --out-name verter_wasm ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/verter_wasm.wasm
scripts.build:wasm: pnpm run build:bindgen && pnpm run opt:wasm
scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:ts
